ns2:course.label: The Art of 3D Imaging
ns2:course.description: Investigation of the three-dimensional modeling capabilities of 3D Studio Max software through a series of original tutorials, class projects and individual problems. The emphasis will be on quality of form and content rather than technical expertise. The end result will culminate in the understanding and production of limited edition digital prints. This course may not be repeated for credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: This course may not be repeated for credit.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
